description.en: Creates the soccer goal model used in in-match scenes (data/chr/option/goal01.xc, via CMND_CREATE_CHARA kind 3), waits for it to load, shows it and returns its handle. Remove it with EndUseGoalModel.
true to give the goal a shadow.
